review:
Book of Vikings takes the book mechanic to Scandinavian seas. It is a 5x3, 10-payline slot with Viking helmets, longships and warriors, plus a book symbol that triggers the bonus.

Free spins feature an expanding symbol, chosen at the start of the round, which spreads across whole reels to complete wins on any line. There are no unusual extras: the game relies on the classic format. In-game information advertises a maximum of 5,500x, slightly higher than many book slots. The RTP is 96.5%. A good choice if you like book games but want a Norse theme instead of Egypt.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
